source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Φιλόσοφος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Philosophos is his name and not a description: the page glosses it as it glosses every other name it prints, «(φίλος + σοφία) = ο φίλος της σοφίας», and the couplet plays on it, «Φιλόσοφος κλήσει τε και έργω μάκαρ» — a philosopher by calling and by work. It says the things about his life were told by Antony the Great, «Τα σχετικά με τον βίο του αφηγήθηκε ο Μέγας Αντώνιος», which is the one `related` row. The corpus's other philosophers — Cyril, Heron, Justin, John of Georgia — carry the word as an epithet and none of them is this man; it holds no other Philosophos. It prints no year and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
